Parnassus Investments increased its stake in Starbucks Corp. (SBUX) by 4.94% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Parnassus Investments bought 594,883 shares as the company’s stock rose 19.14% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 12.65 million shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $718.88 million, up from 12.05M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Parnassus Investments who had been investing in Starbucks Corp. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $78.41B market cap company. The stock increased 0.19% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $63.2. About 11.31 million shares traded. Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has risen 10.74% since December 28, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.74% the S&P500.
Parnassus Investments, which manages about $10.39 billion and $26.19 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) by 23,015 shares to 1.96 million shares, valued at $394.81 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Fortive Corp. by 58,840 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 893,250 shares, and cut its stake in Cognizant Technology Solutions (NASDAQ:CTSH).
